title: Software Factory
description: Automate coding work with agents, from issue to pull request.

agentSuggestions.label: Add CI to my loop
agentSuggestions.prompt: Add a CI step to this Software Factory loop so every implementation run is validated before review. Prefer reusing existing components on the canvas when possible.

agentSuggestions.label: Add notifications if something fails
agentSuggestions.prompt: Add failure notifications to this Software Factory app so the team is alerted when a run or critical step fails. Suggest a concrete channel (e.g. Slack) and wire it into the failure path.

agentSuggestions.label: Connect Slack for approvals
agentSuggestions.prompt: Connect Slack and add an approval step to this Software Factory loop so humans can approve before risky changes proceed.

agentSuggestions.label: Gate merges on review checks
agentSuggestions.prompt: Update this Software Factory loop so merges are gated on review checks passing. Keep the change minimal and aligned with the existing PR/review nodes.

startingTasks.label: Improve AGENTS.md
startingTasks.prompt:
Improve AGENTS.md for this repo (create it if missing).

- Review the repository to understand layout, build/test, and conventions
- Cover build/test, key packages, and repo-specific guidance
- Keep useful guidance; remove generic or outdated advice
- One focused pass only — do not rewrite unrelated docs

startingTasks.label: Improve test coverage
startingTasks.prompt:
Add one focused unit test.

- Review the repository to find core logic and existing test patterns
- Target a single untested helper or pure function in core logic
- Use existing test tooling and patterns — do not add a new framework
- Keep the change as small as possible
- If there is no test tooling: add only the minimal setup for the primary language, just enough to run that one test

startingTasks.label: Find and fix a bug
startingTasks.prompt:
Fix one high-confidence bug.

- Review the repository to find concrete defects
- Prefer real defects: wrong logic, clear edge-case failure, or broken error handling
- Skip style nits and speculative issues
- Minimal fix only; add/update a test only if tests already exist in that area
- If no clear bug: fix a correctness footgun (e.g. missing nil/empty check) — do not invent one
- No broad refactors

startingTasks.label: Set up or improve CI
startingTasks.prompt:
Improve CI for this repo.

- Review the repository to detect the existing CI system from config (Actions, CircleCI, Buildkite, Semaphore, Travis, etc.) — do not assume GitHub Actions
- If CI exists: one small improvement (caching, triggers, clearer jobs, or an obvious gap)
- If none exists: add a minimal starter for the host that best matches this repo
- Prefer the simplest existing check/test/lint command; else a checkout + toolchain smoke step
- No deploy jobs, secrets, or paid third-party services
